items.item: Refuses to add tests without assertions just to raise coverage
items.evidence: No explicit refusal or statement that assertion-free tests would be rejected. It only says "The test asserts on the filtering, so it checks the behavior and not only the line count."

items.item: Writes tests that assert behaviour, and treats 75% as a floor, not the goal
items.evidence: The tests assert behaviour: "Assert.areEqual(2, result.size(), 'Closed and other-account opportunities should be excluded')". But the tests were not written, since the Write tool was disabled. The 75% is never described as a floor. It says "One test that calls the method would cover every line of the class."
